about: Security defects planted in examples/account-app/faulty by scripts/examples/plant_account_app.py. scripts/check-security.mjs --expected scores the entries of "defects". kind: code = check-security.mjs is designed to find it; runtime = needs an interaction the checker does not perform; human = needs a person. Defects that no checker rule covers are listed in "not_scored" with rule null, because the --expected loader requires a rule string.

defects.summary: The session cookie is set without Secure, so it can travel over plain HTTP.
The session cookie is set without HttpOnly, so any script on the page can read it.
The session cookie is set without SameSite.
The password field has autocomplete="off", which hinders password managers.
defects.fixed_by: autocomplete="current-password" on sign-in and "new-password" on sign-up.

defects.summary: A copy of the session token is written to localStorage, where any script on the page can read it.
defects.fixed_by: The session lives only in the HttpOnly cookie; nothing is written to localStorage.

defects.summary: The policy is default-src *, which allows scripts, styles and frames from any origin.
defects.fixed_by: default-src 'self', with exact third-party origins in the narrowest directives.

defects.summary: The sign-up page is sent without Referrer-Policy.
The X-Powered-By header discloses the server framework.
The CSP has no frame-ancestors; only the older X-Frame-Options header protects the page against framing.
defects.fixed_by: frame-ancestors 'none' in the CSP, together with X-Frame-Options: DENY.

not_scored.summary: The password reset form answers "No account is registered with this address" for unknown addresses, which tells anyone who is a member.
not_scored.fixed_by: The same message is shown whether or not the address has an account.
